turns.content: For rigid-rotor 12C32S, identify the lowest pure rotational absorption transition and relate its frequency to the rotational constant B.
Derive the bond length using B=mu r^2 in place of I=mu r^2.
Calculate the reduced mass from the 12C and 32S isotopic masses.
Calculate the C-S bond distance and state whether absorption drives an upward or downward rotational transition.
Check the factor of two in nu=2B, the reduced-mass moment of inertia, and the distance scale.
Report the bond distance as a rigid-rotor spectroscopic estimate with nonzero model and measurement uncertainty.
